advertiserBusinessId.description: TikTok business ID of the ad's advertiser when available. Pass it as `advertiserBusinessId` with `advertiserName` to search only that advertiser.

format.description: Creative format: `video` for video ads, `images` for photo or carousel ads. Null when no creative is reported.

items.description: Video creative for a TikTok Ad Library ad.

videos.description: Every video creative reported for the ad. `video` is the first entry. Empty for image ads.

imageUrls.description: Image URLs for photo or carousel ads, in display order. Empty for video ads.

category.description: Ad category as TikTok labels it, such as `News & Entertainment`, when available.

auditStatus.description: Review status code exactly as TikTok reports it, such as `1`. TikTok does not document these codes. Null when not reported.

rejectionReason.description: Rejection details as TikTok reports them, when the ad was rejected. Null otherwise.

moderation.description: TikTok's review information for the ad.

isUnavailable.description: Whether TikTok reports the ad as no longer available, when known.

ad.description: Ad details when found; otherwise null.

requestId.description: Unique request identifier for tracing this API call.

version.description: Public API version that served the response.

meta.description: Metadata describing the request and billing outcome.
